title: HELIX Bridge: Workday Student → AidApplication
architecture_notes: Equivalent PeopleSoft records: PS_STDNT_AID, PS_ISIR_CONTROL, PS_ISIR_STUDENT, PS_ISIR_COMPUTED, PS_STDNT_AID_ATRBT, PS_STDNT_FA_TERM. Attribute names match bridge/peoplesoft/cs/aid_application_mapping.json one for one, so PeopleSoft and Workday land in the same HELIX shape and can be reconciled directly.

source_objects.description: Each ISIR transaction loaded for the student and award year, with the active transaction flagged.
The student's financial aid record for an award year: application status, dependency, verification selection.
Comment codes and C-flag conditions returned by FPS on the ISIR.
Event recording an approved dependency override.

notes: RESTRICTED. This is a FERPA education record and GLBA-covered customer financial information. Land in bronze under the restricted KMS key, tokenize SAI, COD loan IDs, and PJ or appeal text at silver, and grant only to financial aid roles (govern/access-control-matrix.json, ACM-SPECIAL-002).
validate: Workday object and field names follow Workday Student Financial Aid naming but vary by release and tenant configuration. VALIDATE each against your tenant's report data sources before building RaaS or Web Services extracts.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Deterministic UUID from institution_id + ISIR Record.Reference_ID.
Resolve Universal ID or Student ID to HELIX Student.helix_id. Same person as the PeopleSoft EMPLID through identifier-xref.
Workday award year label. Normalize to 'YYYY-YYYY'.

attribute_mappings.transformation: 'fafsa' when an ISIR exists; other application types are tenant-configured.
